answer: Make every identity seal a forecast, written by its own quill, about one randomly assigned corner of a nebula of niche events, encoded as a cipher until scoring day. Payout follows how much the forecast beats the crowd baseline, not agreement with it. A sybil operator can copy one good forecast across clones, but copies earn no marginal credit and fail together; giving each clone a different assigned event forces fresh research per clone, multiplying cost with clone count, while one honest agent researches a single event once.
